freeze_order: Written before downloading or inspecting train.json in this audit
objective: Audit reference truth theta, page assertion V and provenance feasibility; Y remains unobserved

selection.eligibility: Nonempty string claim and label exactly Supported or Refuted; no other content, access, atomicity, URL or provenance filters
selection.rank: Ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 string W1-v1|{zero_based_train_index}|{claim_text}, tie break train index
selection.interpretation: Label-balanced feasibility sample, not a prevalence estimate

access.scope: All nonempty original_claim_url, cached_original_claim_url, fact_checking_article, question-answer source_url and cached_source_url values in the selected 12 records
access.deduplication: Exact URL string after surrounding whitespace removal only; do not infer independent sources from URL/domain differences
access.fallback: One browser-tool open of each distinct nonarchive URL with insufficient local content, and direct inspection of relevant locally downloaded pages; do not search for replacement claims/pages. Additional opens/finds within the same page allowed. Record access method and failures separately.
access.historical_status: A current page or redirect is not evidence of its content at claim time; mark temporal qualifications. An archive URL timestamp alone is not proof of readable historical evidence.

annotations.theta: Dataset fact-check reference, qualified by time/scope and inspected evidence; never absolute truth or human verification
annotations.V: Binary 1/0 only if inspected page asserts or explicitly rejects the SAME full scoped claim; otherwise null with reason quote_only, partial, mixed, unclear, unavailable, temporal_mismatch or irrelevant
annotations.reference_role: Factchecker verdicts are evaluator-only reference pages, not independent ordinary source-error observations
annotations.provenance: Explicit attribution, common upstream, duplicate content, URL reuse or unknown; different domains do not establish independence
annotations.review_status: AI-assisted provisional annotations; human signoffs zero

decision.page_candidate: Readable frozen excerpt/text with locator, determinate full-claim V, explicit temporal scope and role
decision.case_candidate: At least one nonreference page_candidate plus a reviewable qualified reference theta; otherwise quarantine
decision.stage_go: Report feasibility candidates and natural error/dependence examples, if present; no automatic W2 signoff or W3 authorization
decision.stop: Finish all 12 records including failures, report NO_GO/REVISE when prerequisites fail; no replacement or label relaxation
